Talk to the…

A recorder for long semi-structured interviews. It records once, straight through, while you navigate the questions — then hands you the recording and a timeline of everything you marked along the way.

  • ●Nothing leaves this device. There is no server behind this page. The recording and the notes stay in your browser until you save them.
  • ●One file, not one per question. A conversation that stops and starts is not a conversation. What you say between questions is kept too.
  • ●It works offline. Load this page once and you can run an interview with the network off.
  • ●In the room or on a call. On a video call it records the call audio alongside your microphone, so both halves are captured.

The question sets in this page are public, versioned artifacts from the Farm Hack question-sets library. The answers are not: questions federate, answers do not.

Saving gives you two files — the recording, and a sidecar holding consent, your marks and your notes. Any Farm Hack box can ingest the pair as they are, and transcribe them locally. Built 2026-09-19 from question-set snapshot 2026-09-19, library fd7374a.

Before we record

This interview runs

Read this aloud: I would like to record our conversation so I do not have to rely on my notes. The recording stays on this device and then on our own Farm Hack boxes — ours here, and the machine we use to turn speech into text. It does not go to any outside company. We keep a backup copy, and you can say where. You can ask me to stop at any point, ask for something to be struck from the record afterwards, and decide separately whether you are quoted by name.
